title: NZ Hopes Week and Challenge
location: Hamilton (outside our region, open to Wellington juniors)
details: TTNZ development week for under-12 and under-13 players: three training-camp days (16-18 Jan) then the Challenge on Wednesday 20 Jan. Players must attend all five days. Entry fee for Wellington and lower North Island players: $200.
